Confirm only existing fuel=petrol and powertrainKind=combustion for these four identified 2020 variants. Preserve engine volume, output, gearbox, drive, body, year and manual data. PHEV / Cooper S E ALL4 and 189/192 hp variants excluded. Generic Mini Countryman is constrained by its existing 2020, 1499 cc, 100 kW / 136 hp identity; no drivetrain inference.
